what: A batch newly appended to the end of the list unfolds from height 0 to full height in .6s, pushing the rows below down, while the whole batch settles from 20px above in .8s (both cubic-bezier(.54,.53,.1,.99)). When the end marker enters the screen it fires fx:more so the caller appends the next batch — an endless news list

options.dur: Duration over which height unfolds (s), default .6
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name or ”0.54,0.53,0.1,0.99”), default original curve
options.ahead: Signals the end this many px before it reaches the bottom of the screen, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=batch]: Newly added group (anywhere in the list) — the original group is left as is
options.[data-fx-part=more]: (if present) end marker — when visible, fires an fx:more event on the element
options.fx:more: The writing side receives it and attaches the next batch (when all are attached, the end marker is cleared)

from.where: news.html News list load more — the batch wrapper of the original /common/dist/news/list: height 0 → measured height 600ms cubic-bezier(.54,.53,.1,.99), animation translateY(-20px) → 0 .8s same curve, height initial when done
